notes: False-alarm trap. The chart contains a penicillin allergy (AllergyIntolerance/allergy-pcn) and an active amoxicillin order (MedicationRequest/mr-amoxicillin), so a model that pattern-matches 'penicillin allergy + amoxicillin' will wrongly flag a critical allergy-medication conflict. It must not. The allergy record has verificationStatus = 'entered-in-error', meaning it was recorded by mistake and retracted; per FHIR semantics it is not a valid clinical assertion and must be treated as if absent. With no valid allergy on file, there is NO real conflict: the correct flag list is empty and there is no genuine hazard. Flagging a conflict here is both a clinical-correctness error (the empty-gold rule drops CC to 0 for any flag emitted) and a Safety false-alarm. Metformin, lisinopril, and atorvastatin are unrelated active distractors.
